svg.text: Vanitra glove unit v2 — wiring schematic

ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 N16R8 · 5 flex (4.5" fingers, 2.2" thumb) + 4 SS49E Hall on ADC1, 100 nF on every analog input · plug-in glove harness · MPU6050 + OLED on I2C · MAX98357A · LDO power · pins from firmware/glove_unit/config.h
FLEX DIVIDERS: R + 100 nF to GND
SS49E HALL (magnets on fingertips): OUT -> J2 -> 100 nF -> ADC
+ 100 nF across VCC-GND at each SS49E (on the glove, next to the sensor)
MPU6050 AD0 -> GND (0x68). Mount it on the cuff side of J3
(4-wire JST-SH) so the glove can be washed.
• Fingers use 4.5" flex (covers both knuckles); divider R = √(Rflat·Rbent):
22k for 4.5", 33k for the 2.2" thumb (was 47k on all).
• 100 nF on every analog pin: steadier ADC, no channel crosstalk.
• Glove plugs into the cuff (J1 flex, J2 Hall, J3 IMU): washable, repairable.
• MT3608 boost removed: battery -> LDO -> 3V3; amp runs from VSYS.
• Battery divider moved after the switch (no drain when off).
• Firmware flags a cracked flex (pin stuck at GND/3V3) and low battery.
POWER v2 (no boost converter: quieter sensor rail, fewer parts)
VSYS = battery after the switch (3.4–4.2 V): feeds the MAX98357A and the
battery divider. The board's 5V pin stays free (USB only).
Switch the battery OFF while USB is plugged in.
